ranking.name: German
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Falko-MERLIN: about 24k sentences; original MERLIN supplies grammar and orthography annotation.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case government, determiner/adjective agreement, verb agreement and constrained verb placement.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Capitalization, compounds, letter confusions and observed misspellings.
ranking.assessment: LT plus DWDSmor; lexical coverage and German/Austrian/Swiss variants need explicit handling.

ranking.name: Czech
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: GECCC: 83,058 sentences across four domains, with both native and learner errors.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case, gender/number agreement, verb agreement, constrained preposition government.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Diacritics, i/y and other attested spelling confusions.
ranking.assessment: MorphoDiTa enables morphological checks; corpus breadth is exceptional. Morphological ambiguity still needs vetoes.

ranking.name: Ukrainian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: UA-GEC 2.0: 33,735 sentences; professional corrections, explicit grammar/spelling labels, separate GEC-only version.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case, gender, number, verb forms and constrained prepositions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Observed spelling, apostrophes and word-boundary errors.
ranking.assessment: CC BY 4.0; exclude fluency/calque/style tags. Strongest match to the requested annotation contract.

ranking.name: Italian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: MERLIN plus CItA combine L2 and L1 error evidence; MERLIN is openly downloadable.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Determiner/adjective and subject/verb agreement, constrained clitics and verb constructions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Doubled consonants, h, accents, apostrophes and word boundaries.
ranking.assessment: Morph-it plus checker resources; retain syntactic conditions and avoid changing a valid tense to another valid tense.

ranking.name: Spanish
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: COWS-L2H includes error annotations and instructor-corrected essays, some with multiple corrections.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Gender/number, articles, person agreement, locally constrained prepositions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Accents, h and b/v confusion candidates, with lexical/contextual screening.
ranking.assessment: FreeLing/LT; holistic corrections must be filtered. Broad ser/estar swaps and dialect substitutions are unsafe. Verify data-specific reuse terms.

ranking.name: Estonian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: EstGEC-L2: 3,721 annotated dev/test sentences from 258 texts; Tartu resources add L1/L2 material. Separate spelling benchmark.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Nominal and verb inflection, agreement, constrained government and negation.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Letter quantity, diacritics, capitalization and whitespace.
ranking.assessment: EstNLTK; reserve existing benchmark tests. EKI corpus is restricted and its MultiGEC references are fluency-oriented, not automatically minimal corrections.

ranking.name: French
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: FRIDA provides error-tagged learner evidence; Grammalecte and LT offer explicit rule resources.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Determiner/adjective and subject/verb agreement, restricted participle agreement and verb constructions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Accents, homophones, doubled letters, elision/apostrophes.
ranking.assessment: First implementation group by user decision. Strong rule infrastructure; FRIDA bulk access/reuse and context-sensitive corruption checks remain unresolved.

ranking.name: Turkish
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: GECTurk: 25 expert-curated rules, 138k synthetic sentences reported by repository, plus human-annotated movie-review evaluation.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Morphology-conditioned suffix and clitic transformations; audit breadth beyond orthography.
ranking.proposed_spelling: de/da and ki boundaries, question particle, apostrophes and harmony-sensitive writing rules.
ranking.assessment: Very close to DaLA method. Synthetic counts are not observed-error counts; reversibility alone does not prove incorrectness.

ranking.name: Russian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: RULEC-GEC supplies typed correction edits; direct access requires a request.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case government, adjective/noun agreement, person/number, constrained verb constructions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Orthographic endings, soft signs and observed misspellings.
ranking.assessment: Broad potential but access and reuse terms need resolution; avoid blanket tense/aspect swaps and treating optional orthography as errors.

ranking.name: Slovenian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Solar 3.0 has 5,485 student texts, teacher corrections and exported correction-frequency lists.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case, gender/number including dual, adjective agreement and verb agreement.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Observed spelling and spacing corrections.
ranking.assessment: Sloleks helps generation; teacher marking can be incomplete. Check exact corpus release terms, including NC restrictions, separately from article license.

ranking.name: European Portuguese
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: COPLE2 documents spelling, grammar and lexical error annotation; Portuguese LT includes spelling dictionaries and replacement pairs.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, determiners, contractions and tightly conditioned clitic/preposition constructions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Accents, consonant confusions, boundaries and attested misspellings.
ranking.assessment: Slight lead on observed learner-error evidence via COPLE2; annotated export scope and reuse remain unresolved. Separate standard-specific filters and accepted-variant vetoes required.

ranking.name: Brazilian Portuguese
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Empirical nonword spelling study; small native-authored GEC benchmark; CoGrOO and Portuguese LanguageTool rule resources.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, determiner/adjective forms, constrained contractions/crasis and verb/preposition constructions; contextual lexical confusions audited separately.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Diacritics and cedilla, insertion/deletion/substitution/transposition, observed confusions and guarded word boundaries.
ranking.assessment: Close behind pt-PT: useful spelling evidence and rule infrastructure, but broad naturally observed minimal grammar corrections not verified. Benchmark is constructed and Internet normalization is excluded.

ranking.name: Catalan
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Strong Softcatala dictionaries, morphology and LT rule/test infrastructure; broad natural correction corpus not verified here.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, determiner/elision and narrowly constrained clitic constructions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Accents, diaeresis, apostrophes, geminated l and boundaries.
ranking.assessment: Promising rule-driven route, but observed-error frequency and independent evaluation need more work; preserve accepted regional forms.

ranking.name: Latvian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: LaVA has manually checked morphology and manually annotated learner errors; MultiGEC lists 1,015 texts.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case, gender/number, agreement and constrained government.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Diacritics, vowel length and observed spelling patterns.
ranking.assessment: LUMII morphology analyzes and generates inflections. Confirm bulk annotation access and corpus-specific reuse permission.

ranking.name: Greek
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: GLC/GNC correction resources; MultiGEC GLCII contains 1,289 texts with minimal corrections.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, gender/case and constrained verb morphology.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Stress marks and homophonous vowel spellings.
ranking.assessment: Strong empirical spelling evidence; ensure a substantial grammar component and resolve corpus access. Arbitrary aspect changes remain unsafe.

ranking.name: Romanian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: RONACC/RoGEC provides roughly 10k correction pairs drawn from broadcast errors and written mistakes.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, case/article forms and constrained clitic constructions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Diacritics, hyphens and i/ii/iii patterns.
ranking.assessment: Useful observed evidence, but broadcast fragments and scope need filtering; download/license verification and lexical guards still needed.

ranking.name: Basque
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Orai GEC-elh-eu: 9m synthetic training pairs, 672 manually revised evaluation examples.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case and auxiliary-agreement candidates, requiring strong syntactic conditions.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Attested spelling patterns and bounded synthetic operators; mine generators carefully.
ranking.assessment: A real GEC starting point, but giant synthetic count does not establish natural-error coverage or precision.

ranking.name: Finnish
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: ICLFI error-annotation research plus Omorfi analyzer/generator/speller.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, case government and constrained negation/verb forms.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Length distinctions, vowel harmony and compound boundaries.
ranking.assessment: Excellent morphology, less ready-to-use minimal correction data verified here. Distinguish colloquial forms from errors.

ranking.name: Slovak
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: CHIBY revision corpus and ERRKORP learner-error resource.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Case and agreement candidates derived from verified learner evidence.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Spelling, diacritics and capitalization revisions.
ranking.assessment: Revision edits need semantic/style filtering; bulk paired access and broad grammar coverage remain unresolved.

ranking.name: Lithuanian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Published GEC work releases mistake-generator and typo code.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Inflection and agreement candidates subject to independent confirmation.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Language-specific spelling transformations from published code.
ranking.assessment: Useful engineering starting point; broad human-corrected evidence not established by this survey.

ranking.name: Bulgarian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Published synthetic dataset has four error classes: articles, pronouns, verb suffix and adjective/noun agreement.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Those four classes are a starting point, not broad coverage.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Separate empirical spelling evidence needs development.
ranking.assessment: Explicit rules help, but narrow synthetic categories and source/variant checks require substantial extension.

ranking.name: Hungarian
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Learner-corpus research documents morphological and spelling errors.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Agreement, case and conjugation candidates need a curated contextual rule inventory.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Accent, stem/suffix and compound-boundary candidates.
ranking.assessment: Morphology-rich opportunity; broad accessible correction-pair data not established here.

ranking.name: Irish
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: An Gramadoir provides grammar-checking rules and lexical resources.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Mutation/agreement candidates after linguistic review.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Spelling and accent candidates supported by checker resources.
ranking.assessment: Good rule leads, but open annotated correction evidence and independent validation not established here.

ranking.name: Welsh
ranking.observed_or_rule_evidence: Cysill grammar/spelling/mutation checker and Cysill Ar-lein corpus research.
ranking.proposed_grammar: Mutation and agreement candidates.
ranking.proposed_spelling: Spelling/accent candidates; register and regional variation require care.
ranking.assessment: A checker service/corpus is not automatically an exportable human-corrected dataset; access and annotation quality need resolution.
